newsitem.title: UK: S&P assigns Sorema claims paying rating of A.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Sorema claims paying rating of A.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Tuesday it assigned a claims paying rating of A to Societe de Reassurance des Assurances Mutuelles Agricoles (Sorema), the main operating entity within the Sorema reinsurance group.
Positive factors for Sorema, which is owned by Groupama SA, include its excellent capital strength, improved operating performance, conservative business approach and technical expretise, S&P said.

"Offsetting issures are the company's short track record of more stabilised results, the likelihood of further softening in premium rates and the growing competition from very large global reinsurance majors in a still consolidating market," the agency said in a statement.
